subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR consolidate its examples into existing sub-agent guidance, or should maintainers intentionally change nested sub-agent policy?
rationale: The correct fix depends on prompt-policy direction because current main already has multiple guidance surfaces and supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware guidance surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and Codex-facing policy together instead of prompt text alone.

options.title: Pause As Covered By Main
options.body: Defer or close the branch if current-main guidance is sufficient and no unique wording is desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware guidance surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is tied to recent current-main prompt/tool-description guidance and merged the related sessions_spawn guidance work.
